Sentence (English): I've used the dishwasher several times since it was installed over 2 months ago.
Comments (English): [ Nice, quiet dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I've used the dishwasher several times since it was installed over 2 months ago. The online purchase was simple, as was the delivery & installation process. Mine was delivered, and installed, on the same day, by the same concierge service, on the date that I had chosen. The concierge service made contact the day before to confirm my time slot. He arrived right on time, and was in and out, in less than 30 minutes, though I had removed my old dishwasher the night before myself. He was professional, courteous, and friendly. The new dishwasher looks fantastic, and is very quiet! I used to run the old dishwasher as I was going to bed, because it was a bit too noisy to run while trying to watch TV. This new Bosch dishwasher doesn't vent steam out of the front of the dishwasher, like my old one did, so when the red "dishwasher running" light goes out, I simply pop the door open a few inches to vent the steam, and let the dishes dry, as other reviewers suggested, and it works like a charm. If you don't run your dishwasher every night, and let dirty dishes sit inside it for several days, you will of course, notice a slight, funky odor when you open the dishwasher door, but that always goes away, and smells fresh again, after the dishwasher has been run. I've got no complaints whatsoever about this purchase, and would do it again.

I have not had a problem with the washing quality though I am a bit particular about how dirty a dish can be before it even goes in the dishwasher. I love the very top silverware tray. I occasionally do find a need for the bottle jets. There's two big annoyances I have come across that determined the 4 star. The door does not lock shut upon cycle startup, any minor dish poking beyond the drawers pops the door open and you have to readjust until the door stays shut to run the cycle. Also the wine glass cleaning, you have to lower the top shelf to fit the wine glasses but then not much fits in the lower section (the washing blades under the upper drawer will hit them). I wish they incorporated a wine cleaning section where the lower utensil bins are as most utensils don't fit there anyway (too tall and again the blade hits) and there's already a silverware tray along the very top. I don't have much use for the lower utensil area and would be better served as an optional wine glass cleaning, especially since those lower utensil bins are removable.

Instead of using the top controls, the PDP715SYVFS allows you to connect to the GE SmartHQ where you can easily control all of the function of the dishwasher. This is extremely convenient. The app also allows you to update the dishwasher's firmware and software. Connecting to the app was easy and the app walks you through the setup process. The PDP715SYVFS is the best dishwasher I have ever owned. It is the first one where the fingerprint resistance door is actually fingerprint resistant. GE has hit a home run with the GE Profile™ Fingerprint Resistant Top Control with Stainless Steel Interior Dishwasher with Microban™ Antimicrobial Protection with Sanitize Cycle. It is a definite ten in my book!

Sentence (English): The dishwasher that has been used for 6 years broke down like this.
Comments (English): The dishwasher that has been used for 6 years broke down like this. As a necessary condition for a harmonious family, one day cannot be delayed. The original m1 model has been discontinued, replaced by the m10, it can be regarded as an upgraded version. There are mainly the following changes: 1. Increased intelligent control, you can make an appointment to wash dishes; 2. Increased the height by about 30mm, mainly because the position of chopsticks and spoons is tiled to the top. This design is great, and the position is placed It is more reasonable to place it; 3. As a dishwasher that can be filled manually, it is more considerate to have a splash-proof funnel, but the drain pipe and power cord are shorter than before, so you must pay attention to this point; 4. NFC stickers and the machine box cover There is damped hovering, these two small details are very high-grade, and the style of a big factory; 5. The recommended dishwashing agent is changed from Bright Dishes to Midea’s own bowl companion, but I still recommend Jianjing.
Comments (Original): 用了6年的洗碗机就这样坏掉了，作为和谐家庭必要条件的设备，一天都不能耽误。原来的m1型号已经停产了，取而代之的是m10，算是升级版吧。主要有以下几点变化：1、增加智能管控，可以预约洗碗了；2、增加了大约30mm的高度，主要是把装筷子和勺子的位置平铺到了最上边，这个设计很棒，位置摆放更加合理了；3、作为可以手工灌水的洗碗机，附带了防溅水漏斗比较贴心，但排水管和电源线都比过去短，这点一定要注意；4、nfc贴和机器箱盖有阻尼悬停，这两个小细节非常上档次，大厂风范；5、推荐的洗碗剂由亮碟改为美的自家的碗伴，不过我还是推荐简镜。

I've had this dishwasher for about 2 years after having a dishwasher from ikea than ran for about 10 years with no problems other than normal maintenance stuff. We have a big family that cooks allot so we run our machine like 2 or 3 times a day. I paid three times what I paid for my last one because I love my other Bosch appliances. At first, I was amazed at how quite it was and how clean all the dishes were. After about a year, every 5-6 months months I'd start getting an error code 31. The bosch dishwasher has a fancy Zeolith drying system. If any water/humidity gets into it, the sensors go off and the machine stops working. You have to power down the dishwasher and wait a day or two (and/or use a hairdryer to blow hot air down the back right drying access point which is the silver looking thing poking up in the back right corner) which clears the code and everything will work great again. For a dishwasher more than 3 times the cost of my last one that ran for almost 10 years with no problems, this is unacceptable. Basically, if for some reason some humidity builds up in the drying ducts like if you run a quick wash and don't have the machine run the high heat to make sure condensation doen't form in the venting ducts, the sensor can get tripped. The machine is absolutely fine but you have to wait for the Zeolith drying sensor to dry out otherwise it thinks water is leaking inside (when that's not the case). What a crappy design. There's no broken parts or anything, the design is just flawed as it allows condensation to falsy create an error code. Of course this started happening right after the 1 year warant expired. I highly recommend a different dishwasher. The sad thing is that if it wasn't for this one design flaw the machine would be great. Now, every 5-6 months I get to stand with a blow dryer blowing down the back vent to clear the error. My time is valuable and paid the premium cost of Bosch to get a primium worry free product. Definatley not the case here.

So I figured I'll just get the fancy one with the best reviews. So let's get down to it. The first one installed, tech turned the machine on for a minute or 2 then opened the door and left it soaking wet. It wasn't drying at all so we had it replaced. Frankly, it's not much better. Thin Q is really cool. App notifications are convenient. There is a basket for eating utensils in the bottom shelf. Why the need for top shelf? It's not removable, really, and NOTHING dries on it. If you are not cleaning the above, it is a complete WASTE of valuable space. Why not put collapsing dish separators as are both sides but not down the center? Confounding. So, what are the most important functions for a dishwasher? To clean and dry right? We have tried a multitude of different scenarios. We did everything by the book. Used LG's recommend cleaning products. It does a great job of cleaning. However drying, that's where this is it's failure. It needs to run for at least 3 hrs to get anywhere close to dry. 1 hour function, nothing will be dry. Top shelf, forget it. Second shelf, even the tops of glasses are wet. Bottom shelf, it dries well but eating utensils in the basket don't completely dry. So if you pull the top and second shelf out first, expect everything on the bottom shelf to be wet from water collecting on the upper shelves. There is moisture residue throughout the machine when you open it. It is an indicator as to what lurks on your dishes.Why not a function where the door opens after the cycle is finished to let out moisture? On a dishwasher this expensive, with all of the best features you would think it would outperform the more modest units? Uhh, NOPE. I don't think it is worth the money.

Sentence (English): We're very happy with performance so far with our dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Pros and cons ] || ---------------- || We're very happy with performance so far with our dishwasher. Here are the pros and cons. PROS Cleaning: works very well Drying: the dishes come out dry Noise: very quiet, can hardly tell it's on Ease of use: easy to load & choose cycle Build: nice solid front panel (we looked at a Bosch and the panel was weak and flimsy) CONS Installation: This was my major disappointment and the reason I'm rating it 4 stars. The manual and illustrations were poor and hard to understand. Equally the connection points on the machine were all over the place and not centrally located. To attach one hose you had to remove a part. The worst connection was the power cord (which was not to supplied and I had to go to Ace and get one! ). I couldn't find the connection box anywhere and finally by going on YouTube discovered it was hidden behind the front kick panel! In contrast the Bosch we considered at a similar price had all connections easily found on the back and included a power cord. Their instructions were easy to understand and even had QR codes for video. The KitchenAid had no way to adjust and level the rear once installed. The Bosch had a front “crank” to level the back. In summary if you're installing it yourself my review might help you with some of the pitfalls. Obviously if you're having your appliance store install your dishwasher then the installation issues won't matter. Performance wise once installed has been excellent so far!

Sentence (English): Bought this dishwasher to replace a GE Profile that failed after only 2 years.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Bought this dishwasher to replace a GE Profile that failed after only 2 years. Sentence (English): We've only had the dishwasher for a few weeks, but we're already really excited about it!
Comments (English): [ Absolutely great, definitely worth the money! ] || ---------------- || We've only had the dishwasher for a few weeks, but we're already really excited about it! First I have to start with the cutlery drawer, which we have for the first time. I don't even know why now. This drawer is simply brilliant: you can take out the clean cutlery using the handle and all the same pieces at once. And thanks to the slant in the drawer, even thicker parts fit in, great. Then adjusting the middle basket is great! Despite the cutlery drawer, larger glasses still fit in and large plates still fit in the lower basket. Since we've never had this before, I have to say it's pretty premium =) The lower basket holds a lot more for us than before with the cutlery basket. And even if you use it correctly, the dishes come out clean. It's just great how this machine washes! Last Butter Not Least, zeolite drying must be highly praised! None of our previous stitches have made the dishes so dry. Hammer! Setting it up was super easy and child’s play using the app. The web connection itself is fun, but not vital for us. We haven't tested the intelligent flushing variant yet, so we're excited about it. The salt and rinse aid consumption is pleasant, despite our hard water. The previous machine had significantly higher consumption. All in all, the best dishwasher we've ever had!
Comments (Original): [ Absolute Spitze, definitiv ihr Geld wert! ] || ---------------- || Wir haben die Spülmaschine erst wenige Wochen, aber die Begeisterung ist bereits jetzt groß! Zunächst muss ich mit der Besteckschublade anfangen, die wir zum ersten Mal haben. Ich weiß mittlerweile gar nicht warum. Einfach genial diese Schubalde: man kann das saubere Besteck am Griff und gleich alle gleichen Teile auf einmal rausnehmen. Und durch die Schräge in der Schublade passen auch dickere Teile rein, klasse.Anschließend ist die Verstellung des mittleren Korb topp! Es passen trotz der Besteckschublade immer noch größere Gläser rein und im unteren Korb immer noch große Teller. Da wir das noch nie hatten muss ich sagen das ist schon premium =)Der untere Korb fasst für uns viel mehr als zuvor mit Besteckkorb. Und selbst wenn man das richtig ausnutzt kommt das Geschirr sauber raus. Einfach klasse wie diese Maschine spült! Last Butter Not Least muss die Zeolith-Trocknung in höchsten Tönen gelobt werden! So trocken hat noch keine unserer bisherigen Maschen das Geschirr gemacht. Hammer!Die Einrichtung war super easy und per App ein Kinderspiel. Die Webanbindung an sich ist witzig, für uns aber nicht lebensnotwendig. Auch die intelligente Spülvariante haben wir noch nicht getestet, da sind wir gespannt. Der Salzverbrauch als auch des Klarspüler ist angenehm, trotz unseres harten Wassers. Da hat die Vorgängermaschine einen deutlich höheren Verbrauch gehabt.Alles in allem die beste Spülmasch8ne die wir je hatten!!!

Sentence (English): We had a Bosch Dishwasher installed in our kitchen when we renovated back in 2002.
Comments (English): [ Replaced a 21 year old Bosch DW and Loving It! ] || ---------------- || We had a Bosch Dishwasher installed in our kitchen when we renovated back in 2002. We loved until it finally died one day and was too old to consider repair.We got this new unit and are in love with it. It has absolutely fantastic arrangement options for everything, expecially with that 3rd upper drawer for utensils instead of the basket down low. Opens up the space on the bottom rack for so much more. I like that there is a red light shining onto the floor when it is running. I like the app and enjoy the fact that it notifies me when the dishes are done. Nobody else in the house will bother with the app though. This leads me to the only shortcomming of our new unit. There is no visible indication of clean dishes on the unit itself. Our old unit had a push button that remained down and a light that remained lit till you emptied your clean dishes and reset that button/light. This new unit ends its cycle and is dark and quiet till you are ready for the next wash. It's pretty easy to miss that you have a load of clean dishes and start to add some dirty ones! I recommend a light to shine on the floor, some color other than red, to indicate all clean. Reset by button press after you get around to emtying it. Make it all optional in the app for those that don't like more lights. That would make it truly perfect. Hope the new unit lasts 21 or more years :)

Sentence (English): I love all the cleaning cycles, and the boost dry.
Comments (English): [ Dishes are really clean ] || ---------------- || I love all the cleaning cycles, and the boost dry. I didn't realize that this particular model doesn't have a separate rinse cycle, which my old dishwasher did. I never really used it though. Also, be aware that on this model the stainless steel look door is NOT really stainless steel but some kind of paint. The only reason it matters is that you can't use stainless steel cleaner on it, so just dampen a soft rag and wipe it down. I do it every time I unload the dishwasher and so far it look beautiful. But I've only had it 2 weeks. I love how quiet it is and how the dishes really come clean with just scrapping. I love the steam, and the sanitize and the cycles are great. It has an autosense cycle so you can just let the dishwasher decide how long it needs to run. There is the Normal cycle which has the prewash cycle and the heavy cycle for pots and pans. And then there is the 1 hour cycle where the dry cycle isn't as hot, and you can wash more delicate things, like a fancy cake stand. Or you can save money and turn the dry cycle off and then just air dry.

Sentence (English): We had a Bosch Dishwasher installed in our kitchen when we renovated back in 2002.
Comments (English): [ Replaced a 21 year old Bosch DW and Loving It! ] || ---------------- || We had a Bosch Dishwasher installed in our kitchen when we renovated back in 2002. We loved until it finally died one day and was too old to consider repair. We got this new unit and are in love with it. It has absolutely fantastic arrangement options for everything, expecially with that 3rd upper drawer for utensils instead of the basket down low. Opens up the space on the bottom rack for so much more. I like that there is a red light shining onto the floor when it is running. I like the app and enjoy the fact that it notifies me when the dishes are done. Nobody else in the house will bother with the app though. This leads me to the only shortcomming of our new unit. There is no visible indication of clean dishes on the unit itself. Our old unit had a push button that remained down and a light that remained lit till you emptied your clean dishes and reset that button/light. This new unit ends its cycle and is dark and quiet till you are ready for the next wash. It's pretty easy to miss that you have a load of clean dishes and start to add some dirty ones! I recommend a light to shine on the floor, some color other than red, to indicate all clean. Reset by button press after you get around to emtying it. Make it all optional in the app for those that don't like more lights. That would make it truly perfect. Hope the new unit lasts 21 or more years :)

It has absolutely fantastic arrangement options for everything, expecially with that 3rd upper drawer for utensils instead of the basket down low. Opens up the space on the bottom rack for so much more. I like that there is a red light shining onto the floor when it is running. I like the app and enjoy the fact that it notifies me when the dishes are done. Nobody else in the house will bother with the app though. This leads me to the only shortcomming of our new unit. There is no visible indication of clean dishes on the unit itself. Our old unit had a push button that remained down and a light that remained lit till you emptied your clean dishes and reset that button/light. This new unit ends its cycle and is dark and quiet till you are ready for the next wash. It's pretty easy to miss that you have a load of clean dishes and start to add some dirty ones! I recommend a light to shine on the floor, some color other than red, to indicate all clean. Reset by button press after you get around to emtying it. Make it all optional in the app for those that don't like more lights. That would make it truly perfect. Hope the new unit lasts 21 or more years :)

Sentence (English): Let's start with the fact that THIS DISHWASHER DOES NOT CLEAN DISHES.
Comments (English): [ Just does not clean dishes ] || ---------------- || Let's start with the fact that THIS DISHWASHER DOES NOT CLEAN DISHES. We've had this since Jan-2021. 7 out of 8 days when we retrieve dishes from this machine in the morning that have been *washed* during the night, we have to re-wash some of the dishes. For a $1,200 dishwasher. That is insane. Clean the filter? Yes, we do that about 1 out of every 3 runs, and the filter is a pain to clean. Use rinse agent? Fill it every time it is low. Tub clean on occasion? Too often to count. Try different cycles? Yes, tried many different ones, even the Heavy cycle, which by the way caused the dreaded \"AE\" code error issue once (and were informed by LG customer support that the Heavy cycle can cause this) so we don't use that cycle anymore. About that \"AE\" code error also, when we've gotten it, the code DOES NOT GO AWAY. Water around the sensor issue, but after drying around the unit, getting the water issue resolved, you cannot undo the error manually. Seems to work on some 48 hour cycle, so even it you address the problem of the water under the sensor, the dishwasher seems to be programmed to wait an allotted time anyway. Good god - who engineers this stuff? Do they live in a house where you need to have a working dishwasher? Don't get me started on their \"outsourced\" version of customer service. It is poor every time I call it. I dread calling it. Great LG -- you save a ton of money off-shoring your customer support, regardless of how poorly the support is for your customers. Good luck with that getting you customer loyalty. Stay away from this model, and probably LG.

Sentence (English): We recently purchased and installed this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Impressed with this dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We recently purchased and installed this dishwasher. We were debating between this model w/the pro dry system and the one just bellow without the pro dry system. While I can't attest to the model without the pro dry feature, I can say that we are happy that we purchased the pro dry system. We had a top of the line Kenmore that we replaced. It served us well and was actually rated at a lower db level than the Kitchen Aid we just purchased. However, the sound level of this model is really not detectably any different than the Kenmore that we had. We are well impressed with how well this unit cleans. My wife is ecstatic with the pro dry system. The glassware literally sparkles. It completely cleaned the tea stains from her Yeti cup. When you open the door from the wash cycle there is very little water remaining in the unit. Only what is sitting on top of a storage bowl that has a lip around it and then it is only drops. There is no standing water in the bottom of the tub. We think that long term this will prevent the buildup of mildew and gunk and thus the odor that was in our old dishwasher. We love the capacity and the functionality of the 3rd rack. We have only had the dishwasher for about 3 weeks but thus far are extremely pleased. We will have to wait and see if it produces the same results long term. Our prior dishwasher served us well for 15 years. So, this one has big shoes to fill.

The arrangement of the tines, bulky utensil basket make it almost impossible to fit a 12qt pot, strainer, serving bowls, plates/bowls on the bottle shelf. 2b. The top shelf does have a lot of room but not very convenient for glassware. 4. If I had realized how SMALL the interior of this dishwasher was, (had no way of seeing this in person befor ordering) I probably would have opted for a different Bosch model. But not sure how the interior would be any larger or better configured.

Comments (English): [ This is a great deal on a great machine ] || ---------------- || 9 years ago i moved into a rental property, it had this dishwasher. I ordered it online, had it delivered and did the install myself. It was a little struggle to install but not because of the machine, because my house needed some upgrades. I love the fact that I could order the exact same machine that has been working great for so many years. Hopefully it will keep working as good as the old one.

Sentence (English): We've had this dishwasher for almost 6 months now.
Comments (English): [ Quiet, Quiet, Quiet ] || ---------------- || We've had this dishwasher for almost 6 months now. I use Cascade Platinum single packets with Jet Blue drying aid and we have city water. I removed the silverware basket and use only the top row for silverware.PROS:- Extremely quiet: I can now stand at our sink and have a conversation with someone- Fantastic job cleaning the dishes: I typically run a normal cycle with the Normal Dry Boost, both Wash Zones, and Temp Boost, it finishes cleaning in about 90 minutes- Top rack is great for all our silverware, but larger serving spoons and/or our chef's knives have to go on the first rack because they are too "fat" to fit- Tons of room for plates and all dishes: our previous dishwasher sometimes need 2 runs to clean a days worth of dishes for my family of 4 (with two teenagers)- DIY install was straight forward and it comes with a plug for those who have an outlet in their dishwasher bay, mine was hard wired and the instructions were clear and concise.CONS (reasons why this is a 4 and not a 5):- Bottle washers are kind of dumb because there isn't enough room on the 2nd shelf for a normal Gatorade bottle thats green and has an orange top from Dick's Sporting Goods, I can put SOME of our bottles on the lower rack and utilize the utensil jets- Does feel a little cheap at times, the racks are ultra light weight which I think makes them feel a little cheap. Our bottom rack was replaced no questions asked when it shipped with a bad wheel and wouldn't slide properly.- Monthly cleaning of the filter in the bottom is still required otherwise your dishes will smell like fish (cheaper brand dish cleaning packets also cause the stinky smell so get the expensive ones)- The app you can get is lackluster, it doesn't display a notification when the dishwasher is finished, nor does it display a notification about the dishwasher's status at all, I have to go into the app all the time to see whats going on -- mainly hoped to use this for my kids to know when to load/unload the dishwasher but the app sucksOverall we are very pleased with the dishwasher's performance, especially the QUIETNESS. This thing is truly the quietest dishwasher we've ever had. I've recommended this model to others with the warning about the bottle jets and the drawer height. I assume the space between drawers is narrower due to the 3rd rack which I am fine with. If I'd have known our bottles wouldn't fit in the 2nd row and use the bottle jets, I would have gotten the cheaper model that doesn't have them.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher comes with a power cord ready for plug-in installation, however, it has an option for hardwire with the junction box model SMZPCJB1UC that is sold separately.
Comments (English): [ Easy installation, plug in ready, hardwire option. ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher comes with a power cord ready for plug-in installation, however, it has an option for hardwire with the junction box model SMZPCJB1UC that is sold separately.Installation was easy, but extra steps to follow if you are selecting the hardwire option because you need to hook up the cables to the junction box and then affix the box to the wall behind the dishwasher. At first I thought the bulky junction box behind the dishwasher wasn't going to allow me to fit the dishwasher under the cabinet as far in, but it fit perfectly. Some tips for the installation is to pay attention to the instructions and follow them in order because if you get ahead of yourself, you will have some issues. The feet adjustment, for example, tells you to measure the height of the opening and then adjust the front feet prior to pushing the dishwasher inside the cabinet. You can adjust a little while it's inside the cabinet, but it's more difficult. The feet are plastic, so be careful using the flathead screwdriver to adjust the feet because the plastic is not that tough. I used a big heavy duty flathead and tapped it with a hammer to turn and it turned fairly easily. There is a plastic self adhesive film you need to install under the counter to protect the counter from the heat, this is due to the door opening during the drying cycle, but since I have granite counters and they resist high heat, I chose not to install the film. I think it's only necessary for wood counters or other materials that are not high heat resistant.I love this dishwasher. It's quiet and it cleans well, even with the 60 minute speed cycle. The door will automatically open once the dishes are done drying. I like this feature because it removes all condensation and the dishwasher is completely dry when you remove the dishes. It comes with a third rack where it has slots to fit silverware and other utensils. The actual utensil basket on the bottom rack is not very big, but this allows more space for bigger items and since you have the third top rack where you can place silverware, you still have enough space. Since the dishwasher is quiet, it has a red light on the bottom that turns on when the dishwasher is running its cycle.

Sentence (English): Now that we have had this for 8 months I feel like I can give it a better review.
Comments (English): [ Does a great job cleaning ] || ---------------- || Now that we have had this for 8 months I feel like I can give it a better review. The machine does an excellent job of cleaning dishes. We have put in various pans that have baked on stuff from the oven and it comes clean. It is very rare that something still has food left on it, and the few times it has in 8 months it comes off if you just put it back in for another wash. We know 2 families that have Bosch dishwashers and they have to pretty much clean their dishes before putting them in because they do not have good luck with their dishes coming clean. We do wish there was a little bit more versatility in the racks with putting different size items in but overall it works well. The machine is a little louder than our GE dishwasher from the late 90's. I would not say its overly loud but if you are looking for something on the very quiet side this is not it. We normally start it when we are going up to bed so it doesn't matter to us. The drying on this is what caught us most off guard. You can start it at 9pm and at 7am it is still on the very warm side. It does dry most things pretty well. If you have kids like us and put in their plastic bowl etc. they will only get dry if you have jet dry in it. We have had no issues with spots on anything glass at all. Overall we have be happy with the dishwasher. Like anything new it takes a little bit of a learning curve on the new layout of the racks compared to your old dishwasher. We are very glad we went with whirlpool over Bosch.

Where as the extended warranty from the appliance store starts at the same time as the manufacturer warranty so when you purchase the 3 or 5 year extended warranty you actually only get 2 or 4 years. He called prior to the scheduled delivery time to check if he could come earlier due to some cancellations instead of just showing up which was appreciated and courteous of him. Removal of old dishwasher and installation of our new dishwasher went great. Always have the installer test all the cycles prior to installing the bottom cover plate so you can inspect for leaks and verify proper function of the dishwasher! This does not mean you need to run it through the complete cycles, because of time restraints.We are very pleased with our new dishwasher. It gets everything very clean and has the capacity for a large load. We have found using the 1 hour wash cycle with Dry Boost on normal seems to work best for us. Time for this setting shows as 2 hours and 4 minutes until completion. We would prefer a shorter time for the complete wash/dry cycles. We also tried the Bottle Jet setting which we were very pleased with it. If you pull your dishes out immediately after completion you will still find some water on them. If you wait until the next morning after running this cycle you will find over 95% of them dry and with no water spots as long as you make sure you use the Rinse Aid. The top shallow rack always seems to still have wet items and have water spots especially if they are plastic or rubber coated. The second/middle rack are usually completely dry & no water spots minus plastic items. The second/middle rack will roll out on it's own every time you open the door, if you have heavy items placed in the front of the rack, as mentioned in previous reviews. Stack heavy items in the back first helps to prevent this problem. The third/bottom rack works very well. Recommend as you pull this rack out that you lift the front of the rack slightly over the door, to help prevent breaking the plastic wheels it rolls on, as other reviewers have noted. All dishes and silverware come out clean with no water spots. We have found that if you use the 1 hour wash cycle without the Dryboost everything is clean but extremely wet and you will have to dry each item by hand. Even if you let it sit overnight. We love how quiet the dishwasher is compared to our old dishwasher which was 28 years old. We always rinse all our dishes prior to loading them so we cannot attest to how clean it will get a very dirty dish but not sure why anyone would put this type of dish into any dishwasher. We have not tested any of the other cycles but did go through them and they add additional time to the total time if selected. We have been using our dishwasher for 18 days at the time of this review on 8/25/23. We would recommend this GE model for future purchases.

Comments (English): [ Very happy with our new dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We had the GE white dishwasher model #GDT670SGVWW installed on 7/28/23 and are mostly happy with our purchase. We might recommend that you purchase the extended warranty directly from GE, rather than through Big George's Witbeck Home Appliance store, like we did. The 3-year plan we purchased, overlaps the one-year original warranty, so we will actually only receive 2 years of coverage. We didn't learn about the GE extended warranty plan until we registered the product, but found out that their plan begins after the original warranty.Although we have only owned the dishwasher for 18 days, we are very pleased with it. Our delivery man, Lez, was great. He confirmed our appointment prior to the delivery and requested if he could come earlier, since some of his other deliveries were canceled/postponed that day. After installation was complete, we requested Lez to test all the cycles before he installed the front bottom panel, to check for water leaks and verify proper operation of the dishwasher. No issues were found. Note that we did not run through the complete cycles, due to time constraints.We have found the best settings for us are the 1-hour Wash with Normal Dry Boost, which shows a total time of 2 hours and 4 minutes. When we have used these settings, there is some water remaining on the plastic items of the top rack, and water spots on the plastic utensils. Most items on the second/middle rack are clean and dry, with the exception of some water on plastic items. The items and silverware on the third/bottom rack have been completely clean and dry. We usually pick up the third/bottom rack over the door when pulling it out, to prevent damage to the wheels, since other reviewers have mentioned the need to replace the wheels due to damage caused by that "bump". We found out that the second/middle rack tends to roll out automatically if heavier items are loaded in the front, as noted by other reviewers. We solved that issue by loading heavier items toward the back. We also tested the bottle jets and thought that they worked quite well.We tried running a load on the 1-hour Wash cycle without the Dry Boost, and found that we needed to hand dry almost everything. even after waiting until the next day to check the load. We have added the Rinse Aid/Jet Dry and that has helped with preventing water spots. We also use Cascade Platinum packets.Overall we are happy with our purchase and would recommend this product. We would prefer a shorter time for the complete Wash/Dry cycle, but they don't appear to build them like the one we replaced that was 28 years old.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher was newly installed by the seller in a home we just bought - never used all manuals inside.
Comments (English): [ The worst dishwasher I have every used. ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher was newly installed by the seller in a home we just bought - never used all manuals inside. We thought this was a plus until we tried to use it. It's honestly the worst dishwasher I've ever had the misfortune of using.First, the manual is garbage. It's general and not specific to any one model, so you don't get any really useful information about the model you have. Instead, there are a lot of features listed with the vague "(some models)" indicated, and at least 80% of them don't apply to this model, so good luck finding out what features your model actually offers.I scanned the QR code, in the hopes of getting some actual info, to be greeted with a message that this dishwasher can connect to WiFi. This turned out to be only true if a separate connector is purchased, but it was virtually impossible to find this information.The dishwasher itself does not feel sturdy or well-made. As soon as I opened the door I was concerned. The dw in our old unit is solid, but the door of this one is light and super flimsy. The racks are awkward, and things don't fit quite right in either. Controls are the absolute minimum, so you can't customize anything aside from the wash settings: normal - heavy - 1 hour. Thanks to the awful manual and zero drying options in the controls, I had to do some research to discover that this model is actually supposed to dry. It absolutely doesn't. It's not that the dishes come out slightly wet; they are all soaking wet. And even if you run the washer at night and don't unload the dishwasher until the next morning, the dishes are still SOAKING wet, like they've just been sprayed with water. The only things that weren't soaked when we tried this were the utensils, but even they were still not dry. It's amazing how poorly this model works. The actual drying options for this model are: towel, dishrack, leave the washer door open for several hours (maybe). If you just want something to wash your dishes, while you do all the extra drying work, this is the model for you. It's really unfortunate that we now have to replace a brand new dishwasher, to get something that does the job properly. We definitely won't be purchasing a GE product. GE clearly does not care about their brand reputation to be selling a product like this.

Sentence (English): We've had Whirlpool appliances over the years, and the last one didn't last very long so on recommendation we bought a Bosch.
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher - worth the premium ] || ---------------- || We've had Whirlpool appliances over the years, and the last one didn't last very long so on recommendation we bought a Bosch. I picked a middle range model - didn't need the features of the 500 or 800. Silverware tray on the top is amazing - such a time saver to lay things out that way. I like the app integration - I dont use it for remote start, but its nice to have some sense of diagnostics, when its done with a cycle, etc. It is a bit louder than I expected - part of that could just be where it was installed - but I expected it to be a bit quieter. Drying was pretty bad until I enabled extra drying in the app - now its fine. Not sure why that's not on by default, and I couldn't find a way to enable from the front panel. Note that if you are replacing an older dishwasher, you may want to look at your water line, electrical, etc ahead of time. The whirlpool that was replaced had those in the cabinet where the dishwasher went, and for the bosch this needs to be under the sink since there isn't room for it - and its safer to have it away from the machine. Installation will require a power box and water line filter (at least ours did) under the sink.

Sentence (English): We've had Whirlpool appliances over the years, and the last one didn't last very long so on recommendation we bought a Bosch.
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher - worth the premium ] || ---------------- || We've had Whirlpool appliances over the years, and the last one didn't last very long so on recommendation we bought a Bosch. I picked a middle range model - didn't need the features of the 500 or 800.Silverware tray on the top is amazing - such a time saver to lay things out that way. I like the app integration - I dont use it for remote start, but its nice to have some sense of diagnostics, when its done with a cycle, etc.It is a bit louder than I expected - part of that could just be where it was installed - but I expected it to be a bit quieter.Drying was pretty bad until I enabled extra drying in the app - now its fine. Not sure why that's not on by default, and I couldn't find a way to enable from the front panel.Note that if you are replacing an older dishwasher, you may want to look at your water line, electrical, etc ahead of time. The whirlpool that was replaced had those in the cabinet where the dishwasher went, and for the bosch this needs to be under the sink since there isn't room for it - and its safer to have it away from the machine. Installation will require a power box and water line filter (at least ours did) under the sink.

Sentence (English): I think everyone who first encountered a dishwasher had similar concerns as me.
Comments (English): [ It arrived in just one day and was packaged neatly. ] || ---------------- || I think everyone who first encountered a dishwasher had similar concerns as me. Will it wash well? Sentence (English): This dishwasher was newly installed by the seller in a home we just bought - never used all manuals inside.
Comments (English): [ The worst dishwasher I have every used. ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher was newly installed by the seller in a home we just bought - never used all manuals inside. We thought this was a plus until we tried to use it. It's honestly the worst dishwasher I've ever had the misfortune of using. First, the manual is garbage. It's general and not specific to any one model, so you don't get any really useful information about the model you have. Instead, there are a lot of features listed with the vague "(some models)" indicated, and at least 80% of them don't apply to this model, so good luck finding out what features your model actually offers. I scanned the QR code, in the hopes of getting some actual info, to be greeted with a message that this dishwasher can connect to WiFi. This turned out to be only true if a separate connector is purchased, but it was virtually impossible to find this information. The dishwasher itself does not feel sturdy or well-made. As soon as I opened the door I was concerned. The dw in our old unit is solid, but the door of this one is light and super flimsy. The racks are awkward, and things don't fit quite right in either. Controls are the absolute minimum, so you can't customize anything aside from the wash settings: normal - heavy - 1 hour. Thanks to the awful manual and zero drying options in the controls, I had to do some research to discover that this model is actually supposed to dry. It absolutely doesn't. It's not that the dishes come out slightly wet; they are all soaking wet. And even if you run the washer at night and don't unload the dishwasher until the next morning, the dishes are still SOAKING wet, like they've just been sprayed with water. The only things that weren't soaked when we tried this were the utensils, but even they were still not dry. It's amazing how poorly this model works. The actual drying options for this model are: towel, dishrack, leave the washer door open for several hours (maybe). If you just want something to wash your dishes, while you do all the extra drying work, this is the model for you. It's really unfortunate that we now have to replace a brand new dishwasher, to get something that does the job properly. We definitely won't be purchasing a GE product. GE clearly does not care about their brand reputation to be selling a product like this.
